mapper.delete: DELETE FROM customer_bookmarks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND business_id = #{businessId}
mapper.select: SELECT cb.id, cb.business_id AS businessId, b.name AS businessName, b.business_type AS businessType, b.address, b.profile_image_url AS imageUrl, b.slug, cb.created_at AS createdAt FROM customer_bookmarks cb JOIN businesses b ON cb.business_id = b.id WHERE cb.user_id = #{userId} AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY cb.created_at DESC
